description: This file defines a React component named ViewCostDetailsModal, which renders a full-screen modal overlay displaying cost details, including a summary view and raw JSON data. It manages state for active tabs, user name fetching, and copy-to-clipboard functionality. The component references external utility functions, API calls, and a ProjectDetail subcomponent.

methods.name: fallbackCopy
methods.description: Performs fallback copy to clipboard using a temporary textarea element when navigator.clipboard is unavailable or fails.

methods.name: loadName
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches user name data based on userId when modal opens or userId changes, with error handling.
